"""The shortcut somebody writes when the grammar walk looks like a lot of work.

This is the one-line reintroduction 0004 exists against, not an obviously wrong
file. It reads like the reasonable thing to do and it hands a string out of a
contributed row to the library's own parser.
"""

from sympy import sympify


def load_hamiltonian(row):
    return sympify(row["hamiltonian"])
